what: On a pinned stage, scrolling drives the image to dig 22× toward a single point (inside a head, a window, a hole) (length 1.1 power3.in, fading out from .85 to .25). At .6, 11 concentric rings that take over that point (stage diagonal × .8^i) appear flattened at .3 wide and .08 tall, expand to 1.4× in .6 power1.in, at 1.1 pass off-screen at 9× in .7 power2.in, and switch off at 1.6. From .5 the stage background color changes over a length of 1.2, and at 1.75 the next scene enters from .92 to .35. It is tied directly to scroll, so rewinding makes it back out in reverse

options.from · to: Background color variable name (--kf-bg → --kf-raised form) — the background changes only when to is set
options.--fx-len: Scroll length while the stage is pinned (css variable), default 300vh
options.[data-fx-part=target]: Point to dig into (if none, 60% height at panel center)
options.[data-fx-part=next]: Scene to switch on after passing (if any)
